artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image is an etching featuring multiple figures in a religious scene. In the foreground, an elderly man, a woman kneeling, and a baby lying on a cloth are depicted. Several cherubic angels surround the baby. To the right, a man in a large cloak kneels with a staff visible behind him. Above, a group of angels with wings is gathered. In the background, there is the structure of a stable, an arched stone building, a bright star in the sky, and distant rolling hills under an open sky.

artworks.title: A View from an East Window in the Old Sugar House, No.3 Norris' Alley, Philadelphia
artworks.medium: pen and ink with watercolor on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a densely packed urban space with buildings and enclosed yards, viewed from an elevated angle. The buildings dominate the composition, with various tones of reddish-brown suggesting brickwork. Fine brushstrokes detail the buildings and their shadows, with a wooden fence and outbuildings in the foreground. In the distance, rooftops and a tree with dark foliage are visible against a pale blue sky. The color palette is primarily earthy tones, creating a historic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Parading Knights in Oriental Costume
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a procession in a court setting. The image depicts a group of figures dressed in elaborate costumes, marching in formation. Their outfits suggest a ceremonial context, characterized by detailed patterns and embellishments, notably gold-toned tunics paired with metallic armor. The central figure is holding a staff, indicating a role of significance or authority. In the background, several figures in fine attire sit as spectators, observing the parade. These spectators are depicted with varied colored gowns and turbans, seated under a patterned canopy-like structure.

artworks.title: Court Amusements with Two Monkeys
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a medieval scene featuring figures, draped tents, and a small monkey. The scene captures a gathering of individuals in detailed garments, characterized by flowing gowns with patterns, elaborate headdresses, and vibrant colors including greens, blues, and golds. The characters appear engaged in various activities, with some holding swords or staffs, while others congregate in conversational groups. A small tent is seen at the forefront, with its curtain drawn back slightly to reveal its interior. At the bottom left, a small monkey is tethered. The background shows architecture with arches, suggesting an outdoor setting. This painting might depict medieval life or public events and is in the style of an illuminated manuscript.

artworks.title: Outdoor Games
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of costumed figures participating in a festive event. The scene is lively with numerous figures dressed in similar, colorful costumes featuring red, green, and white stripes. Some wear masks or headdresses with red crowns. A central pair of figures sits in a position of prominence. To the left, there is a tent, and outside stands a small group of figures in vibrant garments. The background features grassy areas and a red wall with an arched entryway, indicating an outdoor setting, possibly in a fortress or castle grounds. The colors are bright and flat.

artworks.title: Three Men in Red Capes Dancing with Their Partners
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a medieval dance scene with elaborately dressed figures. The image depicts individuals in ornate costumes gathered in an indoor setting. The background features another group of spectators who are observing the dancers. The scene is lively, with movement suggested by the poses of the figures, who appear to be engaged in a dance. The colors are vivid, with a strong contrast between the rich reds, blues, and greens of the garments and the muted tones of the room.

artworks.title: Procession of Knights Viewed by Ladies on a Balcony
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of soldiers in a courtyard with onlookers on a balcony. The soldiers are marching in a formal manner. The setting includes architectural elements such as columns, steps, and an arched entrance. Observers are gathered on a balcony above, draped in fabric. The color palette includes earthy tones with splashes of blue.

artworks.title: Two Dancing Couples Led by Torch-bearing Knights
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a medieval gathering with figures wearing elaborate garments. The image depicts an interior space where several figures are dressed in vibrant, ornate costumes. The figures wear plumed hats and carry various items such as weapons and musical instruments. The backdrop consists of a plain wall punctuated by arched windows and a doorway, through which the blue sky is visible. Onlookers, clad in similarly vibrant attire, are seated against the wall, observing the scene unfolding.

artworks.title: Three Dancing Couples Led by Two Knights in Room with Column
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This painting depicts a group of figures engaged in a social gathering. The scene shows individuals in detailed, colorful attire typical of a historical or medieval setting. The figures are dressed in a variety of long robes and gowns, adorned with hats. The clothing includes intricate patterns and rich hues of green, blue, and red. They appear to be communicating or socializing in a structured environment, perhaps in a court or public gathering space. This is in the style of a medieval manuscript illustration or historical art.

artworks.title: Three Couples in a Circle Dance
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a medieval dance scene with musicians and spectators. The description includes a group of figures in period clothing, gathered in a lively scene featuring a dance or possible theatrical performance. The foreground shows individuals wearing vibrant garments in red, green, and blue, interacting in an organized arrangement. On the left, a figure is holding a long pole with feathered ornaments, and to the right, two musicians play a drum and a wind instrument. The background shows elegantly dressed individuals sitting on a raised platform, watching the activity below. There is a small blue window in the wall, enhancing the indoor setting. The style features bright colors and detailed costumes typical of historical depictions. The painting is in the style of an artist specialized in historical or medieval illustration.

artworks.title: Seven Men in Red Gathered in a Circle
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting a medieval procession. The figures are dressed in vibrant red robes with black fur trim and pointed hats, marching and playing music. The scene is set in an architectural setting with a balcony where other figures are observing. Additionally, a group of armored figures holding torches is present, accompanying the procession. The style of clothing and the overall aesthetic reflect a medieval European setting, with rich detailing in the costumes and intricate patterns. This artwork is in the style of a historical manuscript or illuminated book illustration.

artworks.title: Men in Red, White and Blue Dancing with  Their Partners
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 23.4 cm (9 3/16 in.)
sheet: 33 x 26.4 cm (13 x 10 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene featuring figures in a courtyard setting with musicians. The painting depicts a group of figures clad in vibrant, colorful outfits of red, blue, and white stripes, with some wearing armor or holding pikes. There are several figures in the foreground, moving in pairs or small groups, some holding staffs or pikes. One figure in the background, wearing a feathered hat, is seen pointing. Two musicians play a drum and pipe on a raised platform. In the background, behind an arched architectural feature, several onlookers watch the proceedings from a balcony.

artworks.title: The Cigarette
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting on the floor with bent legs, one hand on the ground and the other raised above her head. She appears weary and is nude, with her head tilted back against the wall. Her long hair falls behind her. A man is seated nearby with his hand near his mouth. The scene includes an overturned chair, a window shutter, and scattered clothing. The background is dark and confined, hinting at an interior setting in disarray.

artworks.title: Unknown subject (Let Him look up into the Heaven and laugh in the bright air)
artworks.medium: engraving and relief-etching (with some aquatint?)//printed in reverse of 1943.3.8974
artworks.description: The image is divided into two sections. The top section consists of geometric shapes and linear patterns. The bottom section shows abstract representations of human bodies in dynamic poses. The figures seem to emerge from or intertwine with intricate patterns resembling waves or fabric. There are elements that resemble masks or faces, reminiscent of theatrical props.

artworks.title: The Ballet Master
artworks.artist: Edgar Degas, executed in collaboration with Vicomte Lepic
artworks.medium: monotype (black ink) heightened and corrected with white chalk or wash on laid paper
artworks.description: We look down onto a shadowy stage with a ballerina and a man in this black and white work on paper. The man stands in the lower left corner of the composition wearing a knee-length jacket and resting his wrists on a tall stick in front of his body. Though his face and head are lost in deep shadow, it seems that he looks toward the ballerina to our right. Up on her toes en pointe, her body faces us but her arms are raised and angled toward the upper left corner of the composition. She turns her upper torso and head to gaze in the direction of her hands. Lighting comes from the front edge of the curving stage and illuminates the man’s pants and undersides of his arms, the dancer’s legs, tutu, and face, and the front part of the stage. The space behind the people is lost in shadow but is marked by strokes and smudges. In the upper left corner the names of the artists are scratched onto the ink that had coated the surface of the printing plate: “Lepic” and “Degas.”

artworks.title: L'heureuse fécondité
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a circular framed scene with an indoor setting. A seated woman is holding a small child while other children are nearby. Objects and architectural elements are visible in the background. The circular border features decorative ivy and a coat of arms with wings.

artworks.title: Bath House
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of naked individuals in a town scene. The image shows a group of naked individuals engaging in various activities within an architectural setting. Background buildings include a castle-like structure. In the foreground, people are interacting with musical instruments, leaning on a wooden beam, surrounded by rustic structures and large columns. The style is intricate with fine lines and attention to detail.

artworks.title: Samson Fighting with the Lion
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man fighting a lion in a detailed landscape. The scene is engraved with intricate line work, depicting a muscular figure engaged in combat with a fierce lion. The man, dressed in historical attire, appears to be pulling the jaws of the lion apart with great force. The background is richly detailed, with a landscape featuring distant hills, trees, and a castle or fortified town. The sky is filled with wispy clouds and birds, and the entire composition is rendered in fine, detailed lines typical of traditional engravings. The drawing captures a dramatic moment, showcasing both the tension of the struggle and the beauty of the natural and architectural elements surrounding the scene.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Catherine
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a battle and supernatural elements. Various figures are engaged in action, possibly depicting a battle or mythical scene. In the foreground, there is a woman in a flowing dress holding a sword, kneeling before a structure emitting or struck by a burst of energy or light. Behind her, a man in armor stands with another sword, overseeing the scene. Surrounding them are numerous figures on horseback. The background shows a bright explosion-like phenomenon with rays and clouds. The landscape includes a village or castle in the distance, set against rolling hills and mountains. The image has intricate linework reminiscent of a woodcut print or detailed engraving.

artworks.title: Animal Studies
artworks.medium: traced monotype in black and red on thin wove paper laid down on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features bold, sweeping lines that form various abstract shapes on a textured background.

artworks.title: Tahitian Shore [recto]
artworks.medium: traced monotype in warm black and brown on off-white wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with water leading towards a mountain range. The horizon is high, with loose, sketch-like brushstrokes creating a textured effect. The color palette is muted, dominated by sepia tones and blacks. The water is depicted with swirling lines, and mountains rise in the background. The sky is lightly sketched with clouds.

artworks.title: Tahitian Shore [verso]
artworks.medium: pencil, blue pencil and (brown wash?)
artworks.description: This image depicts a landscape with rolling hills, treetops at the horizon, and a range of prominent hills in the background. The artwork uses loose brushstrokes to create an impressionistic scene with warm earthy tones of brown, green, and hints of blue. In the foreground, there are bush-like forms leading to a body of water with flowing lines. Larger land forms and hills extend into the background, framing the sky that has a faint wash of color and gentle cloud shapes.

artworks.title: Three Tahitians (Study for "La soeur de charite")
artworks.medium: traced monotype in black, squared in pencil on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures in a simple linear style. One figure is seated with bent knees and an extended arm. The other figure is seated behind and to the side of the first figure, facing slightly left. The figures have minimal facial features and wear hats and simple robes. The background is plain, and the sketch appears to be done in charcoal or a similar medium.

artworks.title: Two Marquesans [recto]
artworks.medium: traced monotype in warm black retouched slightly with an olive pigment
